pull.title: scbuild: tidy up variable names in Build
pull.body:
No functional change. Renames a few variables in `scbuild.Build` for readability.

Epic: None
Release note: None

files.patch:
@@ -18,9 +18,9 @@ func Build(ctx context.Context, initial scpb.CurrentState, stmt tree.Statement) (scpb.CurrentState, error) {

-	b.buildStatement(stmt)
-	return b.output(), nil
+	bs := newBuilderState(ctx, initial)
+	bs.buildStatement(stmt)
+	return bs.output(), nil
 }
